children.text: Participants
Thinkbyte: Devrajsinh Jhala, Vijaya Katari, Harsh Pandya, Sujan Deta, Raghu Gorrela
Key Takeaways
Revamping Thinkbyte's company website and establishing a comprehensive digital marketing strategy that includes SEO, content creation, and website development

Assignments were distributed among team members, with tasks focusing on redefining brand guidelines, conducting competitor research, creating structured website content, and outlining the technological development plan
Deadlines were set for each task, emphasizing the need for a coordinated effort to meet the overall goal of enhancing the company's online presence through a revamped website

Concerns were raised regarding role clarity and task scope, particularly in distinguishing content creation for the website from blog content, highlighting the importance of clear communication in collaborative projects

Future meetings, including a separate session to finalize development technologies and approaches, are scheduled to ensure progress is tracked and the marketing project aligns with Thinkbyte's strategic objectives
Concerns
There were concerns about the clarity of the roles and the scope of the tasks, especially regarding the content creation for the website versus the blog.
Development Plan Creation
Devrajsinh Jhala (Dave) will be outlining the development plan, deciding on technologies and timelines for creating the new Thinkbyte website.
The discussion will involve potential migration to new technologies like Next.js and integration with a content management system (CMS) for more efficient content deployment and SEO benefits.
Dave will prepare a document by Friday and plans to have a detailed discussion with Raghu Gorrela to finalize the development approach.
SEO Strategy Planning
Harsh set a deadline of Wednesday to complete the research, as he will be unavailable after that due to his birthday.
Harsh Pandya is responsible for conducting competitor research to understand their keyword volumes and to derive the SEO strategy for Thinkbyte.
Competitors
The broader analysis will inform various functions such as design, content, and service structure.
Harsh Pandya is already tasked with competitor research for SEO, but Raghu Gorrela suggested expanding the analysis to include competitors across all of Thinkbyte's service offerings, not just SEO.
Brand Guidelines Development
The task involves understanding the color theory and how it resonates with brand values to choose appropriate colors that represent words like innovation, excellence, and customer centricity.
Sujan Deta needs to redefine the brand guidelines for Thinkbyte, incorporating company values and targeted demographics into the color palette and overall design.
Recently Completed Tasks
Tasks were assigned to team members, including redefining brand guidelines, conducting competitor research, creating website content, and outlining the development process.
The team discussed a marketing project focused on revamping their company's website and creating a digital marketing strategy.
Future meetings were scheduled to further discuss development details and technologies.
Website Content Structure
The content strategy will need to be aligned with the brand guidelines and SEO insights, focusing on how to present information cleanly and effectively on the website.
Vijaya Katari is tasked with creating content for Thinkbyte's website, which will be different from blog content, requiring more concise and impactful wording.
Vijaya is to provide a document outlining the basic website content structure, with a follow-up to discuss and refine the approach.
Current Tasks
Harsh Pandya is working on competitor research for SEO purposes.
Vijaya Katari is tasked with researching and structuring website content.
Devrajsinh Jhala is involved in the initial planning for the website's development process.
Decision
The team decided to work on various aspects of a marketing project, including SEO, website content, and website development, with the aim of revamping their company's website.
Business Goals

The goal is to revamp the company's website and to create an effective digital marketing strategy that includes SEO, tailored content, and a modular development approach for easy replication across client projects.
Social Media Strategy
The overall marketing strategy requires consideration of different platforms and scheduling, which would involve the use of internal tools and automation.
This item remains an open issue as no clear action items or deadlines were set during the meeting.
Follow-up Meeting
Raghu Gorrela will set up a separate meeting with Devrajsinh Jhala to discuss development details and decide on technologies.
Action Items
Vijaya Katari
Create website content around the keywords provided by Harsh and put together documentation around how the website content should look by tomorrow.
Raghu Gorrela
Research and work on setting up the necessary infrastructure.
Set up a separate meeting with Devrajsinh Jhala to discuss development details and decide on technologies.
Set up a meeting with Sujan to discuss the development part and decide on the technologies to be used.
Devrajsinh Jhala
Prepare a document outlining the development process, the technologies needed, and the timeline for developing the website, to be shared by Friday.
Sujan Deta
Create a document with all the information about our company and break it down into value points.
Redefine the brand guidelines and share by Saturday.
